falsified_proxies.name: projection-only representability
falsified_proxies.definition: RepDist_C(p, q, w) iff type(p) = TYPE_PROJECTION_C and type(q) = TYPE_PROJECTION_C
falsified_proxies.reasons: Falsified by case where identical projected image P7|P7 has different representability depending on whether the source witness is present or missing.

falsified_proxies.name: outcome-label representability
falsified_proxies.reasons: Falsified by 594 counterexamples and 3 outcome label collisions where the same outcome label 'reconvergence' has different representability depending on source history.

falsified_proxies.name: residue-equivalence collapse
falsified_proxies.reasons: Non-empty residue is an expected byproduct of projection transition and does not equate to collapse of distinction.

negative_semantic_constraints: RepDist_C must not be defined solely by target outcome labels.
RepDist_C must not be defined solely by projected image coordinate pairs.
Non-empty residue must not be equated with collapse of distinction representability.
unresolved_proxy_questions: Does there exist a finite model size where outcome label collisions disappear?
